messages.subject: Interpreting CFA
parts:
Hi GSEMers,

I'm currently testing various SEMs for a list of traits, One thing I would like to get some clarity on is about regressing latent factors onto traits. More specifically if I have a model where two factors are made up of various traits, and then these latent factors are now regressed onto another trait (similar to individual SNPs), how would I interpret these results? I was able to fit this model using usermodel out of curiosity, but its unclear to me what these results mean. 

My goal in this exploration is to see how I could fit a SEM model where a trait of interest is conditioned on various other traits. 

I guess more generally, Im looking for resources to expose me to different modeling architectures and techniques. Guidance here would be much appreciated.

Pedro
